title: Handle exact enabled membership, finite classes and absorbing singletons
statement: Complex balance implies weak reversibility. The ordinary ideal<X^y_r-X^z_r> decides actual enabled class membership by rational Groebner normal forms; complex cycles implement reverse edges at the same nonnegative residual. The source imports effective semilinearity of cyclic initialized Petri reachability to decide class finiteness. On a finite class of N>=2 states, enumerate states and rational pi, choose a spanning tree with minimum symmetrized conductance C_min>0 and obtain the rational physical-time lower bound ell=C_min/(N-1). For an absorbing singleton the nonconstant domain is empty and the gap is+infinity by convention. The finiteness operation is an explicit imported premise, not proved from finite BFS termination alone. The separately cited coordinator proof supplies finite/infinite-class detection by exact closure-versus-pumping dovetailing, so the finite-class certificate need not assume the unread semilinearity theorem.
